governance.name: Simulation-support screen
governance.rule: at least 30 simulated observations and Assumption Support Grade C or better
governance.rationale: A transparent project governance convention for simulation precision, not a regulatory or universal statistical threshold. Thirty draws keeps the P10–P90 spread of a segment's simulated medians reasonably narrow; grade C or better excludes segments whose assumptions the project itself classed as interpolated or placeholder. Passing the screen says nothing about real-market accuracy.
governance.overrideLabel: Ignore the simulation-support screen (make the highest raw-score market the candidate)
governance.overrideNote: With the screen ignored, the candidate is simply the highest raw-score market. Segments that fail the screen stay marked, and the report records that the screen was ignored.

agents.label: Data & Statistical Analyst
agents.purpose: Reads the dataset's quality and its descriptive statistics together: sample sizes, dispersion, correlation structure and the anomalies the detectors found.

agents.label: Market Screening Analyst
agents.purpose: Explains why the shortlist candidate scored as it did, and how it differs from the highest raw-score market and the next eligible candidate.

agents.label: Portfolio Risk & Scenario Analyst
agents.purpose: Interprets the concentration (HHI) change this investment would cause and what the scenario projections imply.

agents.label: Investment Orchestrator
agents.purpose: Combines the three analyses into one structured summary of the selected target, its screening basis, risks and next steps. Runs only after the deterministic checks pass.

rawRank.label: Raw rank

highestRawScoreMarket.label: Highest raw-score market
highestRawScoreMarket.definition: Raw rank 1, whether or not it passes the simulation-support screen.

simulationSupportScreen.label: Simulation-support screen

eligibleRank.label: Eligible rank
eligibleRank.definition: Position among the segments that pass the simulation-support screen.

shortlistCandidate.label: Shortlist candidate
shortlistCandidate.definition: The highest-ranked candidate passing the simulation-support screen: an exploratory model output, not an investment recommendation.

selectedTarget.label: Selected target

supportGrades.label: Assumption Support Grade
supportGrades.definition: The project's internal A–E classification of how a segment's assumptions were constructed and how wide a band was assumed around them. It is not an evidence grade: none of the benchmarks it refers to has been externally verified.

grades.A: Assumptions intended to follow a named primary benchmark; narrowest assumed band (±5–8%).
grades.B: Assumptions intended to follow a primary or secondary benchmark with minor interpolation (±10–12%).
grades.C: City-level benchmark adjusted by a locality-class multiplier (±15–20%).
grades.D: Estimated from comparable segments; wide assumed band (±20–30%).
